decisions.basis: Source mentions and imported provenance are not logical dependency declarations.
decisions.choice: Only semantic-use links explicitly bound to selected depends_on references produce uses_definition edges.

decisions.basis: Dependency graph integrity cannot bypass A04 source correspondence checks.
decisions.choice: Quarantine invalid packets and retain their declared links as unresolved diagnostics; do not infer validated closure from them.

decisions.basis: A topological order of SCCs does not prove consistency, fixed-point semantics or fidelity.
decisions.choice: Separate combinatorial SCC condensation from cycle classification and recursive semantic acceptance.

decisions.basis: A sparse declared graph is not proof that all semantic dependencies were discovered.
decisions.choice: Treat missing packets and absent independent edge denominators as pending readiness.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Two-node mutual definition SCC accepted for joint analysis; a prohibited constraining cycle separately rejected; unbound edge remains unresolved; reverse closure includes all affected nodes.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Consume only author-declared uses_definition edges; resolve all transitive refs; compute strongly connected components; retain edge basis; condense to an execution order without erasing normative cycle restrictions.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Two-node mutual definition SCC accepted for joint analysis; a prohibited constraining cycle separately rejected; unbound edge remains unresolved; reverse closure includes all affected nodes.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
